purpose.statement: COPAUA0C is a CICS COBOL IMS MQ program within the CardDemo Authorization Module. It functions as a Card Authorization Decision Program: it retrieves authorization requests from an IBM MQ request queue, validates card/account/customer data from VSAM files and IMS DB, makes approve/decline decisions based on available credit, writes responses back to an MQ reply queue, and persists authorization records to IMS DB. It processes up to 500 messages per invocation before terminating.

code_references.snippet:
* Program     : COPAUA0C.CBL
      * Application : CardDemo - Authorization Module
      * Type        : CICS COBOL IMS MQ Program
      * Function    : Card Authorization Decision Program
       PROGRAM-ID. COPAUA0C.

MAIN-PARA.
           PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZE    THRU 1000-EXIT
           PERFORM 2000-MAIN-PROCESS  THRU 2000-EXIT
           PERFORM 9000-TERMINATE     THRU 9000-EXIT

           EXEC CICS RETURN
           END-EXEC.

01 WS-VARIABLES.
         05 WS-PGM-AUTH                PIC X(08)  VALUE 'COPAUA0C'.
         05 WS-CICS-TRANID             PIC X(04)  VALUE 'CP00'.
         05 WS-ACCTFILENAME            PIC X(8)   VALUE 'ACCTDAT '.
         05 WS-CUSTFILENAME            PIC X(8)   VALUE 'CUSTDAT '.
         05 WS-CARDFILENAME            PIC X(8)   VALUE 'CARDDAT '.
         05 WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT    PIC S9(4)  COMP VALUE 500.

business_rules.statement: The program processes at most 500 authorization request messages per CICS invocation. Once 500 messages have been processed, the processing loop is terminated.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT    PIC S9(4)  COMP VALUE 500.

ADD 1                            TO WS-MSG-PROCESSED
             ...
             IF WS-MSG-PROCESSED > WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT
                SET  WS-LOOP-END             TO TRUE
             ELSE
                PERFORM 3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ THRU 3100-EXIT
             END-IF

business_rules.statement: If no more messages are available on the MQ request queue, the processing loop ends immediately. The queue is read with a wait interval of 5000 milliseconds before declaring no messages available.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE 5000                       TO WS-WAIT-INTERVAL
           PERFORM 1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE THRU 1100-EXIT
           PERFORM 3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ    THRU 3100-EXIT

IF WS-COMPCODE = MQCC-OK
              ...
           ELSE
              IF WS-REASON = MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE
                 SET NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE TO TRUE
              ...
PERFORM UNTIL NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE OR WS-LOOP-END

business_rules.statement: The card number presented in the authorization request must exist in the Card Cross-Reference (CCXREF) file. If not found, the authorization is declined with reason code 3100 and a warning is logged.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-CCXREF-FILE)
                INTO      (CARD-XREF-RECORD)
                ...
           EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD
               WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL)
                   SET  CARD-FOUND-XREF  TO TRUE
               WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND)
                   SET  CARD-NFOUND-XREF TO TRUE
                   ...

EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CARD-NFOUND-XREF
                 WHEN NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR
                 WHEN NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR
                      MOVE '3100'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON

business_rules.statement: The account linked to the card (via XREF) must exist in the Account master file (ACCTDAT). If not found, a warning is logged and the authorization will ultimately be declined.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-ACCTFILENAME)
                RIDFLD    (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X)
                INTO      (ACCOUNT-RECORD)
                ...
           EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD
               WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL)
                  SET FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR     TO TRUE
               WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND)
                  SET NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR    TO TRUE
                  MOVE 'A002'                TO ERR-LOCATION
                  ...

WHEN NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR
                      MOVE '3100'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON

business_rules.statement: The customer linked to the card (via XREF) must exist in the Customer master file (CUSTDAT). If not found, a warning is logged and the authorization will ultimately be declined with reason code 3100.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-CUSTFILENAME)
                RIDFLD    (WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID-X)
                INTO      (CUSTOMER-RECORD)
                ...
           EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD
               WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL)
                  SET FOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR     TO TRUE
               WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND)
                  SET NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR    TO TRUE
                  MOVE 'A003'                TO ERR-LOCATION
                  ...

WHEN NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR
                      MOVE '3100'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON

business_rules.statement: Credit availability check (primary): If a Pending Authorization Summary segment exists in IMS DB, available credit is calculated as PA-CREDIT-LIMIT minus PA-CREDIT-BALANCE. If the transaction amount exceeds the available credit, the authorization is declined with reason code 4100 (Insufficient Funds).

code_references.snippet:
IF FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
              COMPUTE WS-AVAILABLE-AMT = PA-CREDIT-LIMIT
                                       - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE
              IF WS-TRANSACTION-AMT > WS-AVAILABLE-AMT
                 SET DECLINE-AUTH      TO TRUE
                 SET INSUFFICIENT-FUND TO TRUE
              END-IF
           ...

WHEN INSUFFICIENT-FUND
                      MOVE '4100'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON

business_rules.statement: Credit availability check (fallback): If no Pending Authorization Summary segment exists in IMS DB but the Account record is found, available credit is calculated as ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT minus ACCT-CURR-BAL from the VSAM account file. If the transaction amount exceeds this, the authorization is declined with reason code 4100.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE
              IF FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR
                 COMPUTE WS-AVAILABLE-AMT = ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
                                          - ACCT-CURR-BAL
                 IF WS-TRANSACTION-AMT > WS-AVAILABLE-AMT
                    SET DECLINE-AUTH      TO TRUE
                    SET INSUFFICIENT-FUND TO TRUE
                 END-IF
              ELSE
                 SET DECLINE-AUTH         TO TRUE
              END-IF
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: If the account is not found and no IMS summary segment exists, the authorization is unconditionally declined.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE
                 SET DECLINE-AUTH         TO TRUE
              END-IF
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: An approved authorization response is coded as response code '00' and the approved amount equals the requested transaction amount. A declined authorization is coded as response code '05' with an approved amount of zero.

code_references.snippet:
IF DECLINE-AUTH
              SET  AUTH-RESP-DECLINED     TO TRUE
              MOVE '05'                   TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-CODE
              MOVE 0                      TO PA-RL-APPROVED-AMT
                                             WS-APPROVED-AMT
           ELSE
              SET  AUTH-RESP-APPROVED     TO TRUE
              MOVE '00'                   TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-CODE
              MOVE PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT  TO PA-RL-APPROVED-AMT
                                             WS-APPROVED-AMT
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: Decline reason codes are assigned based on the decline cause: 3100 for card/account/customer not found; 4100 for insufficient funds; 4200 for card not active; 4300 for account closed; 5100 for card fraud; 5200 for merchant fraud; 9000 for all other decline reasons. Approved transactions receive reason code '0000'.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE '0000'                    TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON
           IF AUTH-RESP-DECLINED
              EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CARD-NFOUND-XREF
                 WHEN NFOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR
                 WHEN NFOUND-CUST-IN-MSTR
                      MOVE '3100'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON
                 WHEN INSUFFICIENT-FUND
                      MOVE '4100'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON
                 WHEN CARD-NOT-ACTIVE
                      MOVE '4200'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON
                 WHEN ACCOUNT-CLOSED
                      MOVE '4300'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON
                 WHEN CARD-FRAUD
                      MOVE '5100'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON
                 WHEN MERCHANT-FRAUD
                      MOVE '5200'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON
                 WHEN OTHER
                      MOVE '9000'         TO PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON
              END-EVALUATE
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: The authorization ID code sent in the response is derived from the authorization time from the original request (PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME is moved to PA-RL-AUTH-ID-CODE).

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PA-RQ-CARD-NUM         TO PA-RL-CARD-NUM
           MOVE PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-ID   TO PA-RL-TRANSACTION-ID
           MOVE PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME        TO PA-RL-AUTH-ID-CODE

business_rules.statement: The IMS DB write (update or insert of the authorization detail record) only occurs when the card was found in the XREF file. If the card is not in XREF, no IMS write is attempted.

code_references.snippet:
IF CARD-FOUND-XREF
              PERFORM 8000-WRITE-AUTH-TO-DB  THRU 8000-EXIT
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: When an approved authorization is written to the IMS summary segment, the approved amount is added to PA-CREDIT-BALANCE and the approved count is incremented by 1. The cash balance is reset to zero.

code_references.snippet:
IF AUTH-RESP-APPROVED
              ADD 1                         TO PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT
              ADD WS-APPROVED-AMT           TO PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT
              ADD WS-APPROVED-AMT           TO PA-CREDIT-BALANCE
              MOVE 0                        TO PA-CASH-BALANCE
           ELSE
              ADD 1                         TO PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT
              ADD PA-TRANSACTION-AMT        TO PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: When a declined authorization is written to the IMS summary segment, the declined count is incremented by 1 and the declined amount is accumulated. The credit balance is not changed.

code_references.snippet:
ELSE
              ADD 1                         TO PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT
              ADD PA-TRANSACTION-AMT        TO PA-DECLINED-AUTH-AMT
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: If the Pending Authorization Summary segment does not exist in IMS DB, it is initialized and populated with account/customer IDs before being inserted. If it already exists, it is updated (replaced) in place.

code_references.snippet:
IF NFOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
              INITIALIZE PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY
                REPLACING NUMERIC DATA BY ZERO
              MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID             TO PA-ACCT-ID
              MOVE XREF-CUST-ID             TO PA-CUST-ID
           END-IF
           ...
           IF FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
              EXEC DLI REPL USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                   SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                   FROM (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
              END-EXEC
           ELSE
              EXEC DLI ISRT USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                   SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                   FROM (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
              END-EXEC
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: Each authorization detail record inserted to IMS DB is assigned a composite timestamp key using an inverted Julian date (99999 - YYDDD) and an inverted time-with-milliseconds (999999999 - time), ensuring descending chronological order for IMS segment retrieval.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE WS-CUR-DATE-X6(1:5)         TO WS-YYDDD
           MOVE WS-CUR-TIME-X6              TO WS-CUR-TIME-N6
           COMPUTE WS-TIME-WITH-MS = (WS-CUR-TIME-N6 * 1000) +
                                     WS-CUR-TIME-MS
           COMPUTE PA-AUTH-DATE-9C = 99999 - WS-YYDDD
           COMPUTE PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = 999999999 - WS-TIME-WITH-MS

business_rules.statement: The pending authorization detail record is flagged as PA-MATCH-PENDING when the authorization is approved, and as PA-MATCH-AUTH-DECLINED when declined. The fraud fields (PA-AUTH-FRAUD, PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE) are initialized to spaces for every inserted detail record.

code_references.snippet:
IF AUTH-RESP-APPROVED
              SET  PA-MATCH-PENDING         TO TRUE
           ELSE
              SET  PA-MATCH-AUTH-DECLINED   TO TRUE
           END-IF
           MOVE SPACE                       TO PA-AUTH-FRAUD
                                               PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE

business_rules.statement: If the IMS PSB was scheduled during processing, it is terminated during the cleanup phase before the program returns to CICS.

code_references.snippet:
IF IMS-PSB-SCHD
              EXEC DLI TERM END-EXEC
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: If the IMS PSB is already scheduled (return code TC), the program terminates the existing PSB and reschedules it to ensure a clean scheduling state.

code_references.snippet:
IF PSB-SCHEDULED-MORE-THAN-ONCE
              EXEC DLI TERM
              END-EXEC
              EXEC DLI SCHD
                   PSB((PSB-NAME))
                   NODHABEND
              END-EXEC
              MOVE DIBSTAT     TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           END-IF

business_rules.statement: MQ messages are read without syncpoint (MQGMO-NO-SYNCPOINT), meaning each message is destructively dequeued immediately without transactional rollback capability. MQ responses are also put without syncpoint (MQPMO-NO-SYNCPOINT).

code_references.snippet:
COMPUTE MQGMO-OPTIONS  =  MQGMO-NO-SYNCPOINT + MQGMO-WAIT
                                  +  MQGMO-CONVERT
                                  +  MQGMO-FAIL-IF-QUIESCING

COMPUTE MQPMO-OPTIONS     =  MQPMO-NO-SYNCPOINT +
                                        MQPMO-DEFAULT-CONTEXT

business_rules.statement: After processing each message (MQ GET, decision, MQ PUT, IMS write), a CICS SYNCPOINT is issued to commit IMS changes. The IMS PSB-scheduled flag is then reset to 'N' so a fresh PSB scheduling occurs for the next message.

code_references.snippet:
ADD 1                            TO WS-MSG-PROCESSED
             EXEC CICS
                  SYNCPOINT
             END-EXEC
             SET IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD            TO TRUE

business_rules.statement: The MQ reply message is sent as a reply-type message (MQMT-REPLY) with the correlation ID from the original request, targeted at the reply-to queue specified in the request message descriptor. The reply message has an expiry of 50 (tenths of a second) and is not persistent.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE MQMT-REPLY           TO MQMD-MSGTYPE     OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE WS-SAVE-CORRELID     TO MQMD-CORRELID    OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE MQMI-NONE            TO MQMD-MSGID       OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE SPACES               TO MQMD-REPLYTOQ    OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE SPACES               TO MQMD-REPLYTOQMGR OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE MQPER-NOT-PERSISTENT TO MQMD-PERSISTENCE OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE 50                   TO MQMD-EXPIRY      OF MQM-MD-REPLY

inputs.statement: MQ Request Queue: Authorization request messages are read from the IBM MQ queue whose name is retrieved from the trigger data (MQTM-QNAME) at program initialization. The message format is a comma-delimited string containing date, time, card number, auth type, expiry date, message type/source, processing code, transaction amount, merchant category code, acquirer country code, POS entry mode, merchant ID/name/city/state/zip, and transaction ID.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS RETRIEVE
             INTO(MQTM)
             NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC
           IF EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
              MOVE MQTM-QNAME              TO WS-REQUEST-QNAME
              MOVE MQTM-TRIGGERDATA        TO WS-TRIGGER-DATA
           END-IF

CALL 'MQGET' USING W01-HCONN-REQUEST
                              W01-HOBJ-REQUEST
                              MQM-MD-REQUEST
                              MQM-GET-MESSAGE-OPTIONS
                              W01-BUFFLEN
                              W01-GET-BUFFER
                              W01-DATALEN
                              WS-COMPCODE
                              WS-REASON
           END-CALL

UNSTRING W01-GET-BUFFER(1:W01-DATALEN)
                    DELIMITED BY ','
                    INTO PA-RQ-AUTH-DATE
                         PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME
                         PA-RQ-CARD-NUM
                         PA-RQ-AUTH-TYPE
                         ...

inputs.statement: CCXREF VSAM File (Card Cross-Reference): Keyed by card number (XREF-CARD-NUM, 16 characters). Used to resolve a card number to its associated account ID and customer ID.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-CCXREF-FILE             PIC X(08)  VALUE 'CCXREF  '.

EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-CCXREF-FILE)
                INTO      (CARD-XREF-RECORD)
                LENGTH    (LENGTH OF CARD-XREF-RECORD)
                RIDFLD    (XREF-CARD-NUM)
                KEYLENGTH (LENGTH OF XREF-CARD-NUM)
                RESP      (WS-RESP-CD)
                RESP2     (WS-REAS-CD)
           END-EXEC
COPY CVACT03Y.

inputs.statement: ACCTDAT VSAM File (Account Master): Keyed by account ID (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X, 11 characters). Provides account credit limit (ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT), current balance (ACCT-CURR-BAL), and cash credit limit (ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT) used in credit availability calculation.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-ACCTFILENAME            PIC X(8)   VALUE 'ACCTDAT '.

EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-ACCTFILENAME)
                RIDFLD    (WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X)
                KEYLENGTH (LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID-X)
                INTO      (ACCOUNT-RECORD)
                LENGTH    (LENGTH OF ACCOUNT-RECORD)
                RESP      (WS-RESP-CD)
                RESP2     (WS-REAS-CD)
           END-EXEC
COPY CVACT01Y.

inputs.statement: CUSTDAT VSAM File (Customer Master): Keyed by customer ID (WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID-X, 9 characters). Used to verify that the customer associated with the card/account exists.

code_references.snippet: 05 WS-CUSTFILENAME            PIC X(8)   VALUE 'CUSTDAT '.

EXEC CICS READ
                DATASET   (WS-CUSTFILENAME)
                RIDFLD    (WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID-X)
                KEYLENGTH (LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-CUST-ID-X)
                INTO      (CUSTOMER-RECORD)
                LENGTH    (LENGTH OF CUSTOMER-RECORD)
                RESP      (WS-RESP-CD)
                RESP2     (WS-REAS-CD)
           END-EXEC
COPY CVCUS01Y.

inputs.statement: IMS DB Pending Authorization Summary Segment (PAUTSUM0): Root segment in the IMS hierarchy under PSB PSBPAUTB, keyed by account ID (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID). Used to retrieve the current credit limit and credit balance for authorization decision-making.

code_references.snippet:
05 PSB-NAME                        PIC X(8) VALUE 'PSBPAUTB'.
          05 PCB-OFFSET.
             10 PAUT-PCB-NUM                 PIC S9(4) COMP VALUE +1.

EXEC DLI GU USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
               SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
               INTO (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
               WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
           END-EXEC
COPY CIPAUSMY.

outputs.statement: MQ Reply Queue: Authorization response messages are sent to the reply-to queue specified in the incoming request's MQ message descriptor. The response is a comma-delimited string containing card number, transaction ID, auth ID code, response code, response reason code, and approved amount.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE MQMD-CORRELID OF MQM-MD-REQUEST
                                           TO WS-SAVE-CORRELID
              MOVE MQMD-REPLYTOQ OF MQM-MD-REQUEST
                                           TO WS-REPLY-QNAME

CALL 'MQPUT1' USING W02-HCONN-REPLY
                               MQM-OD-REPLY
                               MQM-MD-REPLY
                               MQM-PUT-MESSAGE-OPTIONS
                               W02-BUFFLEN
                               W02-PUT-BUFFER
                               WS-COMPCODE
                               WS-REASON
           END-CALL

STRING PA-RL-CARD-NUM         ','
                  PA-RL-TRANSACTION-ID   ','
                  PA-RL-AUTH-ID-CODE     ','
                  PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-CODE   ','
                  PA-RL-AUTH-RESP-REASON ','
                  WS-APPROVED-AMT-DIS    ','
                  DELIMITED BY SIZE
                  INTO W02-PUT-BUFFER
           END-STRING

outputs.statement: IMS DB Pending Authorization Summary Segment (PAUTSUM0): Updated (REPL) if it already exists, or inserted (ISRT) if new. Updated with new credit balance, approved/declined counts and amounts after each authorization.

code_references.snippet:
IF FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
              EXEC DLI REPL USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                   SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                   FROM (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
              END-EXEC
           ELSE
              EXEC DLI ISRT USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                   SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                   FROM (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
              END-EXEC
           END-IF

outputs.statement: IMS DB Pending Authorization Detail Segment (PAUTDTL1): A new child segment is inserted under the PAUTSUM0 root for each authorization processed. It contains the full authorization request and response details including card number, amounts, merchant data, response code, reason code, approved amount, match status, and fraud flags.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC DLI ISRT USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
                SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                FROM (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
                SEGLENGTH (LENGTH OF PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
           END-EXEC
COPY CIPAUDTY.

outputs.statement: CICS Transient Data Queue 'CSSL': All error and warning events are written to the CSSL transient data queue as structured error log records containing application ID, program name, date, time, location code, error type, error codes, message, and event key.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS WRITEQ
                TD QUEUE('CSSL')
                FROM (ERROR-LOG-RECORD)
                LENGTH (LENGTH OF ERROR-LOG-RECORD)
                NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC

processing_logic.statement: STEP 1 - INITIALIZATION (1000-INITIALIZE): The program retrieves MQ trigger data via CICS RETRIEVE to determine the request queue name. A 5-second (5000 unit) MQ wait interval is set. The MQ request queue is opened in shared-input mode. The first message is read from the MQ request queue to prime the processing loop.

code_references.snippet:
1000-INITIALIZE.
           EXEC CICS RETRIEVE
             INTO(MQTM)
             NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC
           IF EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
              MOVE MQTM-QNAME              TO WS-REQUEST-QNAME
              MOVE MQTM-TRIGGERDATA        TO WS-TRIGGER-DATA
           END-IF
           MOVE 5000                       TO WS-WAIT-INTERVAL
           PERFORM 1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE THRU 1100-EXIT
           PERFORM 3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ    THRU 3100-EXIT

processing_logic.statement: STEP 2 - OPEN MQ REQUEST QUEUE (1100-OPEN-REQUEST-QUEUE): Calls MQOPEN with MQOO-INPUT-SHARED to open the request queue for reading. On success, sets the queue open flag. On failure, logs a critical MQ error (location M001) and terminates.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE MQOT-Q             TO MQOD-OBJECTTYPE OF MQM-OD-REQUEST
           MOVE WS-REQUEST-QNAME   TO MQOD-OBJECTNAME OF MQM-OD-REQUEST
           COMPUTE WS-OPTIONS = MQOO-INPUT-SHARED
           CALL 'MQOPEN' USING W01-HCONN-REQUEST
                               MQM-OD-REQUEST
                               WS-OPTIONS
                               W01-HOBJ-REQUEST
                               WS-COMPCODE
                               WS-REASON
           END-CALL
           IF WS-COMPCODE = MQCC-OK
              SET WS-REQUEST-MQ-OPEN TO TRUE
           ELSE
              MOVE 'M001'          TO ERR-LOCATION
              ...

processing_logic.statement: STEP 3 - SCHEDULE IMS PSB (1200-SCHEDULE-PSB): Schedules PSB PSBPAUTB using EXEC DLI SCHD. Handles the duplicate-schedule condition by terminating and rescheduling. Sets the PSB-scheduled flag on success; logs critical IMS error (location I001) on failure.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC DLI SCHD
                PSB((PSB-NAME))
                NODHABEND
           END-EXEC
           MOVE DIBSTAT        TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           IF PSB-SCHEDULED-MORE-THAN-ONCE
              EXEC DLI TERM
              END-EXEC
              EXEC DLI SCHD
                   PSB((PSB-NAME))
                   NODHABEND
              END-EXEC
              MOVE DIBSTAT     TO IMS-RETURN-CODE
           END-IF
           IF STATUS-OK
              SET IMS-PSB-SCHD           TO TRUE
           ELSE
              ...

processing_logic.statement: STEP 4 - MAIN PROCESSING LOOP (2000-MAIN-PROCESS): Iterates over available MQ messages. For each message: extracts the request, processes the authorization, increments the counter, issues a CICS SYNCPOINT, resets the PSB flag, then reads the next message or terminates if the 500-message limit is reached or no more messages are available.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM UNTIL NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE OR WS-LOOP-END
             PERFORM 2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG THRU 2100-EXIT
             PERFORM 5000-PROCESS-AUTH        THRU 5000-EXIT
             ADD 1                            TO WS-MSG-PROCESSED
             EXEC CICS
                  SYNCPOINT
             END-EXEC
             SET IMS-PSB-NOT-SCHD            TO TRUE
             IF WS-MSG-PROCESSED > WS-REQSTS-PROCESS-LIMIT
                SET  WS-LOOP-END             TO TRUE
             ELSE
                PERFORM 3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ THRU 3100-EXIT
             END-IF
           END-PERFORM

processing_logic.statement: STEP 5 - EXTRACT REQUEST MESSAGE (2100-EXTRACT-REQUEST-MSG): Unstrings the comma-delimited message buffer into individual authorization request fields. Converts the alphanumeric transaction amount to numeric using FUNCTION NUMVAL.

code_references.snippet:
UNSTRING W01-GET-BUFFER(1:W01-DATALEN)
                    DELIMITED BY ','
                    INTO PA-RQ-AUTH-DATE
                         PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME
                         PA-RQ-CARD-NUM
                         ...
                         PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-ID
           END-UNSTRING
           COMPUTE PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT =
                               FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-TRANSACTION-AMT-AN)

processing_logic.statement: STEP 6 - PROCESS AUTHORIZATION (5000-PROCESS-AUTH): The authorization pipeline: (1) Schedule IMS PSB; (2) Read XREF record; (3) If card found: read account, read customer, read IMS auth summary, read profile data (stub); (4) Make authorization decision; (5) Send MQ response; (6) If card found: write to IMS DB.

code_references.snippet:
SET APPROVE-AUTH                  TO TRUE
           PERFORM 1200-SCHEDULE-PSB         THRU 1200-EXIT
           SET CARD-FOUND-XREF               TO TRUE
           SET FOUND-ACCT-IN-MSTR            TO TRUE
           PERFORM 5100-READ-XREF-RECORD     THRU 5100-EXIT
           IF CARD-FOUND-XREF
              PERFORM 5200-READ-ACCT-RECORD  THRU 5200-EXIT
              PERFORM 5300-READ-CUST-RECORD  THRU 5300-EXIT
              PERFORM 5500-READ-AUTH-SUMMRY  THRU 5500-EXIT
              PERFORM 5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA THRU 5600-EXIT
           END-IF
           PERFORM 6000-MAKE-DECISION        THRU 6000-EXIT
           PERFORM 7100-SEND-RESPONSE        THRU 7100-EXIT
           IF CARD-FOUND-XREF
              PERFORM 8000-WRITE-AUTH-TO-DB  THRU 8000-EXIT
           END-IF

processing_logic.statement: STEP 7 - READ MQ REQUEST MESSAGE (3100-READ-REQUEST-MQ): Calls MQGET with wait, no-syncpoint, convert, and fail-if-quiescing options. Saves the correlation ID and reply-to queue name for response routing. Sets NO-MORE-MSG-AVAILABLE if MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE is returned.

code_references.snippet:
COMPUTE MQGMO-OPTIONS  =  MQGMO-NO-SYNCPOINT + MQGMO-WAIT
                                  +  MQGMO-CONVERT
                                  +  MQGMO-FAIL-IF-QUIESCING
           MOVE WS-WAIT-INTERVAL      TO MQGMO-WAITINTERVAL
           ...
           CALL 'MQGET' USING W01-HCONN-REQUEST
                              W01-HOBJ-REQUEST
                              ...
           END-CALL
           IF WS-COMPCODE = MQCC-OK
              MOVE MQMD-CORRELID OF MQM-MD-REQUEST TO WS-SAVE-CORRELID
              MOVE MQMD-REPLYTOQ OF MQM-MD-REQUEST TO WS-REPLY-QNAME
           ...

processing_logic.statement: STEP 8 - MAKE AUTHORIZATION DECISION (6000-MAKE-DECISION): Evaluates credit availability against the transaction amount using IMS or VSAM data. Sets approve/decline flags and codes. Formats the response message into the PUT buffer.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE PA-RQ-CARD-NUM         TO PA-RL-CARD-NUM
           ...
           IF FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
              COMPUTE WS-AVAILABLE-AMT = PA-CREDIT-LIMIT
                                       - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE
              ...
           STRING PA-RL-CARD-NUM         ','
                  ...
                  INTO W02-PUT-BUFFER
           END-STRING

processing_logic.statement: STEP 9 - SEND MQ RESPONSE (7100-SEND-RESPONSE): Constructs the MQ message descriptor with reply type, correlation ID, non-persistence, and 5-second expiry. Calls MQPUT1 to open the reply queue, put the response, and close in a single call.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE MQOT-Q               TO MQOD-OBJECTTYPE OF MQM-OD-REPLY
           MOVE WS-REPLY-QNAME       TO MQOD-OBJECTNAME OF MQM-OD-REPLY
           MOVE MQMT-REPLY           TO MQMD-MSGTYPE     OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE WS-SAVE-CORRELID     TO MQMD-CORRELID    OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           ...
           CALL 'MQPUT1' USING W02-HCONN-REPLY
                               ...
           END-CALL

processing_logic.statement: STEP 10 - WRITE AUTHORIZATION TO IMS DB (8000-WRITE-AUTH-TO-DB): Calls the update-summary paragraph followed by the insert-detail paragraph to persist the authorization outcome to the IMS database.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM 8400-UPDATE-SUMMARY      THRU 8400-EXIT
           PERFORM 8500-INSERT-AUTH         THRU 8500-EXIT

processing_logic.statement: STEP 11 - INSERT AUTHORIZATION DETAIL (8500-INSERT-AUTH): Obtains current timestamp via CICS ASKTIME/FORMATTIME. Computes inverted date/time keys. Populates the detail segment with all request and response fields. Inserts the child segment (PAUTDTL1) under the appropriate PAUTSUM0 root.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS ASKTIME NOHANDLE
              ABSTIME(WS-ABS-TIME)
           END-EXEC
           EXEC CICS FORMATTIME
             ...
           END-EXEC
           COMPUTE PA-AUTH-DATE-9C = 99999 - WS-YYDDD
           COMPUTE PA-AUTH-TIME-9C = 999999999 - WS-TIME-WITH-MS
           ...
           EXEC DLI ISRT USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
                SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                FROM (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
           END-EXEC

processing_logic.statement: STEP 12 - TERMINATION (9000-TERMINATE): If the IMS PSB is still scheduled, issues EXEC DLI TERM to release it. Closes the MQ request queue via 9100-CLOSE-REQUEST-QUEUE. Program then returns to CICS.

code_references.snippet:
IF IMS-PSB-SCHD
              EXEC DLI TERM END-EXEC
           END-IF
           PERFORM 9100-CLOSE-REQUEST-QUEUE THRU 9100-EXIT

processing_logic.statement: STEP 13 - PROFILE DATA READ (5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA): This step is a stub containing only CONTINUE. No profile data is currently read; the step is reserved for future implementation.

code_references.snippet:
5600-READ-PROFILE-DATA.
           CONTINUE
           .

dependencies.statement: CICS Transaction ID CP00: The program is associated with CICS transaction CP00, which is recorded in error log entries and used to identify the application context.

MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID            TO ERR-APPLICATION

error_handling.statement: Centralized error logging routine (9500-LOG-ERROR): All errors and warnings are routed through this paragraph. It obtains the current timestamp via CICS ASKTIME/FORMATTIME, populates the error log record with program name, transaction ID, date, time, location code, error type, codes, and message, then writes the record to the CSSL transient data queue. If the error is flagged as critical, it invokes 9990-END-ROUTINE to terminate the program immediately.

code_references.snippet:
EXEC CICS ASKTIME NOHANDLE
              ABSTIME(WS-ABS-TIME)
           END-EXEC
           ...
           EXEC CICS WRITEQ
                TD QUEUE('CSSL')
                FROM (ERROR-LOG-RECORD)
                LENGTH (LENGTH OF ERROR-LOG-RECORD)
                NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC
           IF ERR-CRITICAL
              PERFORM 9990-END-ROUTINE
           END-IF

error_handling.statement: Critical vs. Warning error classification: Errors are classified as ERR-CRITICAL or ERR-WARNING. Critical errors trigger immediate program termination via 9990-END-ROUTINE. Warning errors are logged but processing continues.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE 'M001'          TO ERR-LOCATION
              SET  ERR-CRITICAL    TO TRUE
              SET  ERR-MQ          TO TRUE
              ...

WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND)
                   SET  CARD-NFOUND-XREF TO TRUE
                   ...
                   SET  ERR-WARNING     TO TRUE
                   SET  ERR-APP         TO TRUE
                   ...

error_handling.statement: Emergency termination routine (9990-END-ROUTINE): Calls 9000-TERMINATE to clean up IMS and MQ resources (terminate PSB, close queues), then issues EXEC CICS RETURN to return control to CICS.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM 9000-TERMINATE
           EXEC CICS RETURN
           END-EXEC

error_handling.statement: MQ Open failure (location M001): If MQOPEN fails, a critical MQ error is logged with comp code (ERR-CODE-1) and reason code (ERR-CODE-2), and the program terminates.

MOVE 'M001'          TO ERR-LOCATION
              SET  ERR-CRITICAL    TO TRUE
              SET  ERR-MQ          TO TRUE
              MOVE WS-COMPCODE     TO WS-CODE-DISPLAY
              MOVE WS-CODE-DISPLAY TO ERR-CODE-1
              MOVE WS-REASON       TO WS-CODE-DISPLAY
              MOVE WS-CODE-DISPLAY TO ERR-CODE-2
              MOVE 'REQ MQ OPEN ERROR'
                                   TO ERR-MESSAGE
              PERFORM 9500-LOG-ERROR

              SET  ERR-IMS               TO TRUE
              MOVE IMS-RETURN-CODE       TO ERR-CODE-1
              MOVE 'IMS SCHD FAILED'     TO ERR-MESSAGE

code_references.snippet:
ELSE
                MOVE 'M003'                TO ERR-LOCATION
                SET  ERR-CRITICAL          TO TRUE
                SET  ERR-CICS              TO TRUE
                MOVE WS-COMPCODE           TO WS-CODE-DISPLAY
                MOVE WS-CODE-DISPLAY       TO ERR-CODE-1
                ...

                                           TO ERR-MESSAGE

downstream_effects.statement: Requesting System (MQ Reply Queue Consumer): Any system or application that sent an authorization request and is waiting on the designated reply-to queue receives the authorization decision (approve/decline, response code, reason code, approved amount) via MQ. The response is correlated by correlation ID and expires in 50 tenths of a second (5 seconds) if not consumed.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE WS-REPLY-QNAME       TO MQOD-OBJECTNAME OF MQM-OD-REPLY
           MOVE MQMT-REPLY           TO MQMD-MSGTYPE     OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE WS-SAVE-CORRELID     TO MQMD-CORRELID    OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE MQPER-NOT-PERSISTENT TO MQMD-PERSISTENCE OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           MOVE 50                   TO MQMD-EXPIRY      OF MQM-MD-REPLY
           ...
           CALL 'MQPUT1' ...

downstream_effects.statement: IMS DB Pending Authorization Database: The PAUTSUM0 (summary) and PAUTDTL1 (detail) IMS segments are updated or inserted for each processed authorization. Downstream batch processes, reporting, or settlement programs that read this IMS database will see updated credit balances, authorization counts, and the full detail history of each authorization transaction.

code_references.snippet:
IF FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
              EXEC DLI REPL USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                   SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                   FROM (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
              END-EXEC
           ELSE
              EXEC DLI ISRT USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                   SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                   FROM (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY)
              END-EXEC
           END-IF

EXEC DLI ISRT USING PCB(PAUT-PCB-NUM)
                SEGMENT (PAUTSUM0)
                WHERE (ACCNTID = PA-ACCT-ID)
                SEGMENT (PAUTDTL1)
                FROM (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
                SEGLENGTH (LENGTH OF PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS)
           END-EXEC

downstream_effects.statement: CSSL Transient Data Queue (Error/Audit Log): All warning and error events written to CSSL are available to downstream log monitoring, operations dashboards, and audit systems. Each entry is enriched with program name (COPAUA0C), CICS transaction (CP00), timestamp, location code, error classification (APP/IMS/MQ/CICS), error codes, and the event key (typically card number or account ID).

code_references.snippet:
MOVE WS-CICS-TRANID            TO ERR-APPLICATION
           MOVE WS-PGM-AUTH               TO ERR-PROGRAM
           MOVE WS-CUR-DATE-X6            TO ERR-DATE
           MOVE WS-CUR-TIME-X6            TO ERR-TIME
           EXEC CICS WRITEQ
                TD QUEUE('CSSL')
                FROM (ERROR-LOG-RECORD)
                LENGTH (LENGTH OF ERROR-LOG-RECORD)
                NOHANDLE
           END-EXEC

downstream_effects.statement: Credit Balance State in IMS (PA-CREDIT-BALANCE): Each approved authorization increments PA-CREDIT-BALANCE in the PAUTSUM0 segment. This balance is subsequently used by the same program (on future invocations) as the primary source for available credit calculation, making it the authoritative real-time credit utilization record for pending authorizations.

code_references.snippet:
IF AUTH-RESP-APPROVED
              ADD 1                         TO PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT
              ADD WS-APPROVED-AMT           TO PA-APPROVED-AUTH-AMT
              ADD WS-APPROVED-AMT           TO PA-CREDIT-BALANCE
              MOVE 0                        TO PA-CASH-BALANCE

IF FOUND-PAUT-SMRY-SEG
              COMPUTE WS-AVAILABLE-AMT = PA-CREDIT-LIMIT
                                       - PA-CREDIT-BALANCE
              IF WS-TRANSACTION-AMT > WS-AVAILABLE-AMT
                 SET DECLINE-AUTH      TO TRUE
